scope: Preparation only. Synthetic authored Grade 6-8 ELA responses. No participants, records, live model or billing.

open_items.description: Locate the authoritative P-TER-01 v0.2 packet and bind it by hash (freeze --protocol-file).
Locate the current Assessment Construct Codebook and bind it by hash (freeze --codebook-file).
Independent content review of the PROPOSED passage, rubric and responses (Grade 6-8 ELA).
Independent review of the PROVISIONAL key, including ambiguous items and seeded errors.
Independent review that the manual comparator is a fair equivalent of the assisted task.
Confirm whether the protocol requires randomization/counterbalancing and adopt or replace the proposed schedule.
Copy the protocol's measures and thresholds into the manifest as PROPOSALS; they are not validated cutoffs.
Adult tester notice prepared, approved and delivered per protocol before any session.
